passage:
On class photo day, everyone tried to look neat. Hair was combed, uniforms were straight, and shoes were clean.
Just before the photo, a bird flew over and dropped something white on Jack's shoulder. Everyone laughed, and Jack's face turned red.
The teacher quickly helped him clean it, but a small mark remained. Jack wanted to stand in the back.
The photographer said, "Years later, this may be the part you remember most."
Jack stayed in his place. When the photo came back, the mark was almost invisible, but everyone remembered the story.
A perfect photo can show faces. An imperfect moment can hold a memory.
